commit.message:
fix(security): eliminate os command injection across smart_* tools (#169)

* fix(security): eliminate os command injection across smart_* tools

Addresses GHSA-29p3-56wx-ggfh (critical), GHSA-8w8q-fgv9-j286,
GHSA-49mq-fc6q-3h46, and GHSA-76pc-mqxp-3rq5.

- Add src/utils/safe-exec.ts argv-mode helpers (execFileSafe/Sync, spawnSafe)
  plus assertSafeGitRef / assertSafePathArg / assertSafeArg / assertAllowed.
- smart_diff/branch/log/merge/status: replace every execSync string command
  with argv-mode execFileSafeSync; validate refs and paths (GHSA-29p3).
- smart_install: allowlist packageManager, reject option-flag package specs,
  spawn with shell:false (GHSA-8w8q).
- smart_user: route all lookups through argv-mode execFileSafe, replace
  getent||grep/cat pipelines with in-process fallbacks (GHSA-49mq).
- web-server: validate sessionId against ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$ on both
  session-summary and session-events endpoints (GHSA-76pc path traversal).
- CallTool handler now routes validated args downstream; remove ts-expect-error.
- Tighten zod schemas for the affected tools (defense-in-depth).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(security): convert remaining shell sinks to argv mode + add tests

Completes the full audit recommended by GHSA-29p3-56wx-ggfh. Converts every
remaining string-command / shell:true sink across the tool surface to argv-mode
execution and validates caller-controlled inputs:

- build-systems: smart-logs (in-process file tail + argv system logs),
  smart-network (ping host validation), smart-system-metrics (df path),
  smart-build/lint/test/typecheck/docker (shell:false + npx/npm .cmd on win),
  smart-processes (wmic/ps argv).
- system-operations: smart-service (all systemctl/sc/docker control + info ops),
  smart-process (wmic/ps/pstree argv + pid/name validation),
  smart-cron (crontab via stdin, schtasks argv, journalctl argv).
- code-analysis: smart-ast-grep (argv, no command-string concat).
- configuration: smart-package-json (npm/yarn/pnpm list/audit/outdated argv).
- Export isValidSessionId for testing.
- Add tests/unit/security: validator + argv-neutralization + schema-rejection
  + path-traversal regression tests (20 tests).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(security): address review feedback, formatting, and weak-hash alerts

- align web-server session-id pattern with the mcp validator (allow dots)
- drop gnu-only ps --no-headers flag for macos compatibility
- stop passing description as a second /tn flag to schtasks
- replace md5 cache-key hashing with sha256 in smart-user (codeql js/weak-cryptographic-algorithm)
- run prettier on the files flagged by the lint and format check

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(security): standardize session-id validation on the strict no-dot pattern

the review suggestion aligned web-server with index.ts by allowing dots,
but the regression test intentionally rejects dotted ids (a.b, ..) and
session ids are generated as alphanumeric/dash tokens, so dots are never
legitimate. align both validators on ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$ instead.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(security): resolve remaining codeql and dependabot alerts

- web-server: add express-rate-limit (300 req/min) in front of all routes
  (js/missing-rate-limiting) and prove jsonl log paths stay inside the
  hooks data dir via resolve+relative containment (js/path-injection).
- smart-test: escape every regex metacharacter including backslash in a
  single pass before building the jest pattern (js/incomplete-sanitization).
- smart-ast-grep: strip all wildcards from exclude patterns, not just the
  first (js/incomplete-sanitization).
- smart-pretty: strip html tags to a fixpoint so nested tags cannot
  survive a single pass (js/incomplete-multi-character-sanitization).
- deps: hoist npm@^11.16.0 so semantic-release no longer pulls the
  bundled vulnerable brace-expansion@5.0.4 / ip-address@10.1.0
  (dependabot 75 and 83); npm audit now reports 0 vulnerabilities.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: franklinic <franklin@ivorycloud.com>
Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
